claims.text:
Acompoundof thestructure:
NH2
for use in treating a disorder characterized by the presence or development of one or more solid
tumors comprising administering to an individualin need thereof a therapeutically effective
amount of the compound,wherein the disorder is an adenocarcinoma, small celllung carcinoma,
non-small cell lung carcinoma, a melanoma,or a combination thereof, wherein the
adenocarcinomaiscoloncancer.
The use of claim1,wherein the disorderiscolon canceradenocarcinoma.
The use of claim 1, wherein the disorder is a small cell lung carcinoma.
The use of claim1,wherein the disorderis a non-small cell lung carcinoma.
The use of claim 1,wherein the disorder is a melanoma.
